title: Lift wedge annihilates the exterior quotient kernel
statement: Let S be a short exact sequence A→B→C of sheaves of modules on a scheme X, with A finite locally free of rank r1 [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module], and let r2=r1+r3. Using exterior sheaves [def-sc-sheaf-exterior-power], suppose q:(∧^r1 A)⊗(∧^r3 B)→(∧^r1 A)⊗(∧^r3 C) sends tensors of wedges to tensors with each second factor mapped under S.g. There exists w:(∧^r1 A)⊗(∧^r3 B)→∧^r2 B, sending each tensor of wedges to the concatenated wedge of the S.f images and the second tuple, and satisfying kernel.ι(q)≫w=0.

proof.text: Apply exteriorSheaf_wedgeMap_exists to S.f with degrees r1, r3, r2 and hr. This gives w and exactly the concatenated-wedge formula required in the conclusion, without using the quotient or exactness.

Apply determinant_wedge_quotient_factor to the given q and the constructed w, using hq and the formula for w. The short exactness and locally free rank hypotheses match verbatim. Obtain a morphism phi from the quotient tensor with q followed by phi equal to w.

Rewrite w as q followed by phi. Associativity rewrites kernel.ι(q) followed by w as (kernel.ι(q) followed by q) followed by phi. The kernel condition makes the first composite zero, and zero_comp makes the whole composite zero. Pair this equality with the unchanged formula for w.

proof_origin.place: Proof of (*), determinant paragraph; reuse existing wedge construction and quotient factorization, followed by the categorical kernel condition

lean.statement: theorem determinant_liftWedge_kernel_exists {X : Scheme.{v}} (S : ShortComplex X.Modules) (hS : S.ShortExact) (r₁ r₂ r₃ : ℕ) (hr : r₂ = r₁ + r₃) [S.X₁.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank r₁] (q : exteriorSheaf S.X₁ r₁ ⊗ exteriorSheaf S.X₂ r₃ ⟶ exteriorSheaf S.X₁ r₁ ⊗ exteriorSheaf S.X₃ r₃) (hq : ∀ (U : X.Opens) (a : Fin r₁ → S.X₁.val.obj (op U)) (c : Fin r₃ → S.X₂.val.obj (op U)), q.val.app (op U) (tmulSection (exteriorSheafSection S.X₁ r₁ U a) (exteriorSheafSection S.X₂ r₃ U c)) = tmulSection (M := exteriorSheaf S.X₁ r₁) (N := exteriorSheaf S.X₃ r₃) (exteriorSheafSection S.X₁ r₁ U a) (exteriorSheafSection S.X₃ r₃ U (fun i ↦ S.g.val.app (op U) (c i)))) : ∃ w : exteriorSheaf S.X₁ r₁ ⊗ exteriorSheaf S.X₂ r₃ ⟶ exteriorSheaf S.X₂ r₂, kernel.ι q ≫ w = 0 ∧ ∀ (U : X.Opens) (a : Fin r₁ → S.X₁.val.obj (op U)) (c : Fin r₃ → S.X₂.val.obj (op U)), w.val.app (op U) (tmulSection (exteriorSheafSection S.X₁ r₁ U a) (exteriorSheafSection S.X₂ r₃ U c)) = exteriorSheafSection S.X₂ r₂ U (fun i ↦ Fin.append (fun j ↦ S.f.val.app (op U) (a j)) c (Fin.cast hr i))
